notes: Masterplan section 4 and hypothesis H3: the 2026-08 TAVONEL measurement of this model was abnormally low against the official OmniDocBench v1.6 score of 96.58, so this runtime reproduces the model card exactly. Official prompt sha256 sha256:de9617f877f6110d22adf1a6ba2a96221189dc246fb1fef161e408d37bff5267; the 2026-08 run sent sha256:c0fb65bf41705f32189c0e2407d824db52a68a365024239b2029a7a283f64567 (published in benchmark/reports/OVISOCR2_0_9B_VLLM_CU129_OMNIDOCBENCH_DEMO_EVALUATION_2026-08-01.md), which drops the card's leading newline and breaks the line before 'Preserve the original text'. adapter.load() refuses the old spelling by hash. min_pixels 200704 = 448*448 and max_pixels 8294400 = 2880*2880, as literals in the card. The card does not pass trust_remote_code to LLM(); the 2026-08 run did, and it is dropped here - the canary must confirm the checkpoint loads without it. VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn is kept as an operational fix (vLLM forks by default and CUDA cannot re-init in the child); it does not change what the model emits and the effective value is reported in runtime provenance. Model revision moved from the 2026-08 pin 65c619d374b55d4152e85150fc1b003700bc1f0c to 1fc9221b7823a371d6e97f92d527cc847e24e107, but model.safetensors keeps sha256 9270560288656ece5cb3a6989001afcf5af8d223bceed4a423c33a008861d009, so the weights are byte-identical and only repository metadata moved. benchmark/v6/candidate-registry.yaml still records the older revision. Apache-2.0 is a copyright grant only, not patent freedom to operate. shard_size_hint 150 and per_page_timeout_seconds 300 come from the historical 6.171 s/page in masterplan section 5.1; max_concurrency_per_worker stays 1 until the canary raises it. Framework-floor audit (2026-09-03, after the GLM-OCR canary died on an unrecognised model_type): the required framework floor, what the pinned base image actually ships, the action taken and the evidence URLs are recorded in provenance.json under framework_floor_audit. bootstrap.sh asserts the pinned framework versions and that the framework recognises this checkpoint's architecture before anything starts.
